name: hls-player
description: A small browser extension that plays HLS (.m3u8) streams directly in a clean video player.

scripts.lint: npm run vendor && web-ext lint --warnings-as-errors --source-dir extension --ignore-files "**/*.mcp-ng-*"
scripts.build: npm run vendor && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files "**/*.mcp-ng-*"
scripts.release:check: npm run clean:check && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.sign:unlisted: npm run release:check && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted --ignore-files "**/*.mcp-ng-*"
scripts.sign:listed: npm run release:check && npm run source && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code dist/source.zip --ignore-files "**/*.mcp-ng-*"
